Robinhood Stock Tokens Overtake Binance bStocks by Holder Count

Robinhood Stock Tokens have reached about 862,800 holders, surpassing Binance bStocks at roughly 827,200 to become the largest stock-token platform by holder count under Token Terminal’s methodology. Robinhood, one of the largest U.S. retail brokerage platforms, grew the product from zero to its current scale in about two months. Its Stock Tokens are structured as tokenized debt securities that provide economic exposure to underlying stocks or ETFs without granting legal or beneficial ownership of those securities. — link
